en.15 jours ouvrables après complétude du d: 15 working days after the file is complete
en.Selon la décision délivrée par le Minist: According to the decision issued by the Ministry
en.Ce service permet aux entreprises de tra: This service allows industrial processing companies legally established in Togo to obtain customs approval for preferential exports within the UEMOA and ECOWAS area.
en.Le dossier doit démontrer l'origine des: The file must demonstrate the origin of inputs, the reality of local processing, and the documentary compliance of the company.
en.Entreprises de transformation industriel: Industrial processing companies legally established in Togo and engaged in exports to the UEMOA/ECOWAS area.
en.L'entreprise doit être légalement enregi: The company must be legally registered in Togo (NIF & RCCM).
en.La transformation industrielle effectuée: Industrial processing carried out on national territory must be effective.
en.Le produit doit faire l'objet d'une marq: The product must be covered by a registered or protected trademark (OAPI).
en.Frais d'instruction réglementaires : 50: Regulatory processing fees: 50,000 FCFA (payable online after submission).
en.Lettre de demande d'agrément timbrée à 5: Stamped application letter to the Minister (500 FCFA)
en.Justificatif d'enregistrement de la marq: Brand registration certificate or trademark proof
en.Fiche technique détaillée décrivant le p: Technical process and raw materials worksheet
en.Factures d'achat ou certificats d'origin: Purchase invoices or origin certificates for raw materials
en.Soumission de la demande : compléter le: Application submission: complete the citizen form and upload all mandatory supporting documents.
en.Instruction administrative : vérificatio: Administrative review: documentary and technical review of the file by the competent ministry.
en.Paiement et formalisation : en cas d'avi: Payment and formalization: in case of a favorable opinion, the processing fee is paid before the approval is issued.
en.Décision et notification : l'entreprise: Decision and notification: the company receives a notification of approval, rejection, or required corrections.
en.Ministère du Commerce, de l'Artisanat et: Ministry of Trade, Crafts and Local Consumption
en.Coordonnées à confirmer dans l'environne: Contact details to be confirmed in the deployment environment
en.Direction en charge de l'instruction des: Directorate in charge of reviewing UEMOA/ECOWAS approvals
en.Veuillez confirmer les prérequis ci-dess: Please confirm the requirements below before proceeding to the detailed file entry.
en.Je confirme que l'entreprise est légalem: I confirm that the company is legally registered in Togo
en.Je confirme que l'entreprise effectue un: I confirm that the company performs local industrial processing
en.Je confirme que l'entreprise dispose d'u: I confirm that the company has a registered or protected brand (or trademark pending registration with OAPI)
en.Je certifie disposer de toutes les pièce: I certify having all required technical documents in PDF format
en.Caractéristiques des produits faisant l': Characteristics of the products covered by the application
en.Code SH / Nomenclature douanière du prod: HS Code / Customs nomenclature (10 digits HS Code)
en.Description synthétique du processus de: Summary Description of the transformation process
en.Décrivez brièvement les étapes clés de f: Briefly describe the key production steps for this product (min. 50 characters)...
en.Pièces justificatives requises pour l'in: Supporting documents required for processing the file
en.Je déclare et certifie sur l'honneur que: I declare and certify on my honor that the information provided for this approval request is correct and accurate.
en.Je certifie la conformité et l'authentic: I certify the compliance and authenticity of all digitized supporting documents.
en.L'entreprise s'engage à accepter tout au: The company commits to accept any audit or inspection of its facilities by the DDPMI.
en.Je reconnais qu'une fausse déclaration a: Je reconnais qu'une fausse déclaration annule de plein droit l'agrément et expose l'entreprise à des sanctions pénales.
en.En cas d'avis favorable à l'instruction,: If the review is favorable, payment confirms the continuation of the approval issuance process.
en.Aucune donnée exploitable n'est disponib: No usable data is available for the summary yet.
